The two typefaces served from this directory, each in its latin and latin-ext subsets:

Space Grotesk
  Copyright 2020 The Space Grotesk Project Authors (https://github.com/floriankarsten/space-grotesk)

JetBrains Mono
  Copyright 2020 The JetBrains Mono Project Authors (https://github.com/JetBrains/JetBrainsMono)

Both are licensed under the SIL Open Font License, Version 1.1.
The licence's text: https://openfontlicense.org/open-font-license-official-text/

The files were taken from Google Fonts and are served from this site, so that
the page loads nothing from anywhere else.
